Portable 5.00 kWh LiFePO4 power station for home backup and off-grid use. 6000 W continuous output, 10-year warranty, EU Battery Regulation compliant.

Specifications
- Capacity: 5.00 kWh
- Chemistry: Lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4)
- Nominal voltage: 51.2 V
- Continuous output: 6000 W
- Expected lifetime: 4000 cycles
- Weight: 49.5 kg
- Warranty: 10 years

Compliance
EU Battery Regulation compliant.
